acceptance: Protocol IDs are opaque, namespace-qualified, canonical, and reject whitespace/malformed/unknown namespace input.
Git revisions require exact 40-hex SHA identity and SHA-256 revisions require exact 64-hex digest identity.
IdentityRevisionRef cannot be constructed unless both identity and revision validate.
Round-trip parse/serialize is deterministic and canonical.
The public protocol package exports only the identity/revision surface earned by this Grain.
Focused tests plus exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI pass.

required: Positive and negative unit tests for identity, revision, and exact-state reference parsing.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Promote the existing @ineractive/protocol placeholder into the smallest earned public protocol surface without adding dependencies.

requirements: Identity strings never grant authority or capability by themselves.
Revision references must be immutable exact identities; branch names, floating tags, and mutable labels are rejected.

outcome: Ineractive has a minimal provider-neutral public protocol foundation for stable opaque identities and immutable revision references, with deterministic runtime validation and machine-readable schemas.
rationale: First protocol task after canonical SG-000009 framework qualification.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000010 and identity/revision protocol exports/schema/tests; no external or persisted data migration is authorized.

scope_in: Define provider-neutral stable opaque protocol identity primitives.
Define immutable Git SHA and SHA-256 revision reference primitives.
Define a typed identity-plus-revision reference for exact-state binding.
Add deterministic parsers/validators and machine-readable JSON Schema.
Expose only the earned identity/revision public API from @ineractive/protocol.
scope_out: Do not define Run, Event, Evidence, or Finding schemas; those remain IN-P01-S02-T02.
Do not define ModelTask, DecisionTask, CapabilityRequest, or CapabilityGrant.
Do not build the workspace shell or persist protocol objects.
title: IN-P01-S02-T01 Implement protocol identity and revision primitives
